entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number VF78592. It's for the pro-level jersey. I saved up for it and I was so excited.

Okay, I see the order right here, Sarah. Thank you. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I guess. It's the wrong size. It's just... it's much too tight across the shoulders. I feel terrible having to send it back, I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years.

I completely understand, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. It's important that you have gear that fits perfectly. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 25 days ago. Just one moment while I review our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I've had a lot going on... I really was counting on this money coming back. I hope it's not a problem.

No, not a problem at all, Sarah. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David.
You're very welcome. We can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or if you'd prefer, I can set up an exchange for the next size up. There would be no extra charge for that.
An exchange would be perfect! I really do love the jersey, it was just the sizing. So I can get a new one?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange for you in a larger size. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid return label to send back the one that's too tight. Once we see that the return has been scanned by the shipping carrier, we'll send the new one out to you.
That's wonderful. You've really turned my day around. Thank you for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
